sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: The sun slowly began to rise over Katao on Monday September 15, 2014.
sentences.zh: 2014年9月15日，星期一，太阳在龟岛上空缓缓升起。

sentences.en: It promised to be yet another beautiful day on the remote tropical island.
sentences.zh: 这注定又是这座偏远热带岛屿上美好的一天。

sentences.en: Located on the western shore of the Gulf of Thailand,
sentences.zh: 龟岛位于泰国湾西岸，

sentences.en: Katao is the smallest of three islands making up the Chumpan Archipelago.
sentences.zh: 是组成春蓬群岛的三座岛屿中最小的一座。

sentences.en: Accessible only by boat and with only 2,000 permanent residents, the island spans 21 square kilometres of postcard-worthy landscapes.
sentences.zh: 岛屿只能乘船抵达，常住人口仅2000人，拥有21平方公里如明信片般美丽的风景。

sentences.en: Coconut trees abound, with the mangrove jungle giving way to pristine golden sand beaches.
sentences.zh: 岛上椰树成林，红树林丛林一直延伸到原始的金色沙滩。

sentences.en: Imposing granite boulders jut out from the turquoise waters, which are home to coral reefs and marine life.
sentences.zh: 巨大的花岗岩巨石从碧绿的海水中突兀而出，那里是珊瑚礁和海洋生物的家园。

sentences.en: Once a sleepy island inhabited mostly by fishermen, by 2014, Katao had become the mecca for scuba diving in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 龟岛曾是一个以渔民为主的宁静小岛，到2014年，它已成为东南亚的潜水圣地。

sentences.en: Translated in English to Turtle Island, half a million tourists flocked there each year to enjoy its natural beauty, affordable prices, and laid-back lifestyle.
sentences.zh: “龟岛”在英语中意为“Turtle Island”，每年有五十万游客涌向这里，享受其自然美景、实惠的价格和悠闲的生活方式。

sentences.en: For a fraction of the cost of back home, westerners could spend their days diving, exploring, or sunbathing with a cocktail in hand,
sentences.zh: 西方游客只需花在家乡一小部分的钱，就能整天潜水、探险，或者手拿鸡尾酒在阳光下休憩，

sentences.en: before treating themselves to a Thai massage and heading out to one of the many bars that dot the shorelines.
sentences.zh: 之后再享受一次泰式按摩，然后前往散布在海岸线上的众多酒吧消遣。

sentences.en: As dawn approached that Monday morning, a beach cleaner was combing the sands of Siree Beach,
sentences.zh: 周一清晨，黎明将至，一名海滩清洁工正在塞里海滩的沙滩上清扫，

sentences.en: the main tourist hub that houses a majority of the island's bars, dive shops, and accommodation.
sentences.zh: 这里是主要的旅游中心，岛上大部分的酒吧、潜水店和住宿设施都集中于此。

sentences.en: As they neared the reef outside of the ocean-view bungalows, they noticed something among the rocky alcove on the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 当他们靠近海景平房外的礁石时，注意到海岸线上的岩石凹处有些异样。

sentences.en: The body of a white, blonde female was lying on blood-soaked sand.
sentences.zh: 一名白人金发女性的遗体躺在被鲜血浸透的沙滩上。

sentences.en: In the water approximately 12 metres away was the body of a white male floating in the shallow tide.
sentences.zh: 在约12米外的水中，一名白人男性的遗体正漂浮在浅滩的潮水中。

sentences.en: The surrounding water was red with blood.
sentences.zh: 周围的海水被鲜血染成了红色。

sentences.en: When 23-year-old Hannah Witheridge announced her plans to travel to Thailand from her home in Norfolk, England, her parents were apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 当23岁的汉娜·威瑟里奇宣布她计划从英国诺福克的家中前往泰国旅行时，她的父母感到忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: They perceived the foreign country to be a dangerous place for a young woman.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这个外国对年轻女性来说是个危险的地方。

sentences.en: Sue Witheridge tried to talk her daughter out of it, urging Hannah to visit Australia or Europe instead.
sentences.zh: 苏·威瑟里奇试图劝阻女儿，力劝汉娜改去澳大利亚或欧洲旅游。

sentences.en: But Hannah's mind was made up.
sentences.zh: 但汉娜心意已决。

sentences.en: Her last few years had revolved around study and she was eager for a break.
sentences.zh: 过去几年她一直忙于学业，渴望能休息一下。

sentences.en: Having completed a degree in education at the University of East Anglia,
sentences.zh: 在东安格利亚大学获得教育学学位后，

sentences.en: Hannah had begun a postgraduate course in speech and language therapy.
sentences.zh: 汉娜开始攻读言语和语言治疗的研究生课程。

sentences.en: She looked forward to a career centred around helping others, but she also craved some much-needed downtime and adventure.
sentences.zh: 她期待着一份以帮助他人为核心的职业，但也渴望获得急需的放松和冒险。

sentences.en: So, when the possibility of visiting Thailand with a close group of her friends arose,
sentences.zh: 因此，当有机会与一群好友去泰国旅游时，

sentences.en: Hannah jumped at the chance.
sentences.zh: 汉娜毫不犹豫地抓住了这个机会。

sentences.en: Although she promised to contact her parents every day, they remained anxious as she began her journey through the bustling foreign country.
sentences.zh: 尽管她承诺每天都会联系父母，但当她开始这段穿越繁华异国的旅程时，父母依然感到焦虑。

sentences.en: When Hannah reached Katao on September 12, 2014, her parents breathed a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 2014年9月12日，当汉娜抵达龟岛时，她的父母终于松了一口气。

sentences.en: They could finally relax knowing that the island posed little threat, as their daughter would be doing little besides sunbathing and swimming.
sentences.zh: 他们终于可以放心了，因为这座岛屿几乎没有什么威胁，他们的女儿除了晒太阳和游泳，不会做别的事。

sentences.en: Hannah and her friends checked into the Ocean View Bungalows on Siree Beach,
sentences.zh: 汉娜和她的朋友们入住了塞里海滩的海景平房，

sentences.en: a no-frills hotel offering basic facilities within walking distance to a selection of bars and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 这是一家设施简陋的酒店，距离多家酒吧和餐厅仅几步之遥。

sentences.en: The foursome hadn't been there long when they met a pair of fellow British backpackers,
sentences.zh: 这四人组入住没多久，就遇到了两位同行的英国背包客，

sentences.en: David and Chris, who were staying in an adjacent room.
sentences.zh: 大卫和克里斯，他们住在隔壁房间。

sentences.en: Like Hannah, 24-year-old David Miller was dedicated to his studies.
sentences.zh: 和汉娜一样，24岁的大卫·米勒也专注于学业。

sentences.en: Having just completed a degree in civil and structural engineering at Leeds University,
sentences.zh: 大卫刚在利兹大学完成了土木与结构工程学位，

sentences.en: David left his hometown of Jersey in Britain's Channel Islands to spend six weeks undertaking a work placement at a mining company in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他离开家乡英国海峡群岛的泽西岛，前往澳大利亚一家矿业公司进行为期六周的实习。

sentences.en: Deciding to spend some time travelling around Southeast Asia before returning home to complete his master's degree,
sentences.zh: 在回国完成硕士学位之前，他决定花些时间在东南亚旅行，

sentences.en: David ventured to Thailand with his close friend Chris Ware to meet up with some other friends on Katao.
sentences.zh: 大卫与好友克里斯·韦尔一起冒险来到泰国，与龟岛上的其他朋友会合。

sentences.en: David and Hannah and their friends quickly hit it off.
sentences.zh: 大卫、汉娜和他们的朋友们很快就打成了一片。

sentences.en: On the night of Sunday September 14, the group headed out to Choppers, a busy sports bar just off Siree Beach.
sentences.zh: 9月14日星期日晚上，一行人前往塞里海滩附近的繁忙运动酒吧“Choppers”。

sentences.en: As they chatted and laughed over drinks, the bar's owner snapped a photo of the young travellers to promote his venue on social media.
sentences.zh: 当他们边喝边聊、谈笑风生时，酒吧老板拍下了这些年轻游客的照片，以便在社交媒体上宣传他的酒吧。

sentences.en: It captured a smiling Hannah wearing a pink top with her long blonde hair flowing down while her friends pulled faces behind her.
sentences.zh: 照片中，汉娜穿着粉色上衣，留着长长的金发，笑容灿烂，而她的朋友们则在她身后做着鬼脸。

sentences.en: Her mobile phone and small handbag rested on the table in front of her.
sentences.zh: 她的手机和小手提包放在面前的桌子上。

sentences.en: David sat between his friends on the other side of the table, wearing a grey t-shirt with his brown hair combed to the side and a big smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 大卫坐在桌子另一侧的朋友中间，穿着灰色T恤，棕色头发梳向一侧，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。

sentences.en: Just after midnight, Hannah and her girlfriends made their way to the AC Bar, a lively beachfront venue popular with expats and backpackers.
sentences.zh: 午夜刚过，汉娜和她的女性朋友们前往AC酒吧，这是一个深受外籍人士和背包客欢迎的热闹海滨场所。

sentences.en: David and Chris joined them shortly after 2am.
sentences.zh: 大卫和克里斯在凌晨2点后不久也加入了她们。

sentences.en: At some point in the early hours of the morning,
sentences.zh: 在凌晨的某个时刻，

sentences.en: Hannah and David left via the bar's back entrance and walked towards their hotel, into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 汉娜和大卫从酒吧后门离开，走进了黑暗中，朝着他们的酒店走去。

sentences.en: The following morning, police were summoned to the beach outside the Ocean View bungalows.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，警方被传唤到海景平房外的海滩上。

sentences.en: Thailand is a deeply religious country, and the area where police were called was surrounded by temples.
sentences.zh: 泰国是一个宗教氛围浓厚的国家，警方被叫到的地方周围环绕着寺庙。

sentences.en: When they saw what had taken place there, the officers were shaken spiritually.
sentences.zh: 当看到现场发生的一切时，警官们在精神上受到了极大的震撼。

sentences.en: The first officer who arrived on the scene later remarked,
sentences.zh: 第一位到达现场的警官后来感叹道：

sentences.en: I hope God will punish the person who committed this crime.
sentences.zh: “我希望上帝能惩罚犯下这起罪行的人。”

sentences.en: Hannah Witheridge and David Miller's bodies were sprawled on the beach, both having been victims of a brutal attack.
sentences.zh: 汉娜·威瑟里奇和大卫·米勒的遗体横陈在沙滩上，两人都遭受了残酷的袭击。

sentences.en: Hannah was laying in the sand by a looming, rocky wall.
sentences.zh: 汉娜躺在靠近一堵高耸岩壁的沙滩上。

sentences.en: She had been bludgeoned numerous times with a blunt object, causing her death.
sentences.zh: 她被钝器多次击打，导致死亡。

sentences.en: Deep, jagged wounds were all over her face and head.
sentences.zh: 她的脸部和头部布满了深深的锯齿状伤口。

sentences.en: Her upper and lower jaw, forehead, and both eye sockets were broken.
sentences.zh: 她的上下颌、前额和两个眼眶都碎裂了。

sentences.en: She was naked from the waist down, her white skirt pushed up over her torso.
sentences.zh: 她腰部以下赤裸，白色的裙子被推到了躯干上方。

sentences.en: She had been raped, and there were bite marks near her right nipple.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了强奸，右乳头附近有咬痕。

sentences.en: David Miller was floating in the shallow water nearby, naked except for a single black sock.
sentences.zh: 大卫·米勒漂浮在附近浅水中，除了一只黑色袜子外，全身赤裸。

sentences.en: He had also sustained multiple head wounds.
sentences.zh: 他的头部也遭受了多处创伤。

sentences.en: His upper jaw was broken, as were his eye sockets and cheekbones.
sentences.zh: 他的上颌骨碎裂，眼眶和颧骨也一样。

sentences.en: Defence wounds on his hands showed that a struggle had taken place.
sentences.zh: 他手上的防御性伤痕表明曾发生过搏斗。

sentences.en: However, water found in his lungs indicated he had been alive when he was thrown into the sea and that he had ultimately died from drowning.
sentences.zh: 然而，肺部发现的水表明他在被扔进海里时还活着，最终死于溺水。

sentences.en: Hannah and David's clothing was strewn about on the blood-streaked beach, with footprints pressed into the sand around them.
sentences.zh: 汉娜和大卫的衣物散落在血迹斑斑的沙滩上，周围的沙地上留下了脚印。

sentences.en: Underneath a fallen log nearby was a blood-stained garden hoe typically used for digging beachside fire pits.
sentences.zh: 附近一根倒下的圆木下有一把沾血的园艺锄，通常用于挖掘海滩篝火坑。

sentences.en: The hoe belonged to a local man, who had actually found it before the police and taken it back to his garden, only returning it once he realised its significance.
sentences.zh: 这把锄头属于当地一名男子，他实际上在警察之前就发现了它，并把它带回了自己的花园，直到意识到它的重要性才交还。

sentences.en: The police also collected three L&M brand cigarette butts, a black flip-flop shoe, and a used condom.
sentences.zh: 警方还收集了三个L&M品牌的烟头、一只黑色人字拖和一只用过的避孕套。

sentences.en: The condom contained Hannah's DNA, but according to police, it was too contaminated to recover anyone else's.
sentences.zh: 避孕套中含有汉娜的DNA，但据警方称，污染太严重，无法提取其他人的DNA。

sentences.en: However, semen staining on Hannah's body was viable for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 不过，汉娜遗体上的精液痕迹可用于DNA检测。

sentences.en: DNA was also lifted from the cigarette butts.
sentences.zh: 警方也从烟头上提取了DNA。

sentences.en: At the time, there were only six police officers stationed on Katao, and their inexperience with major murder investigations quickly became evident.
sentences.zh: 当时，龟岛上只有六名警官，他们缺乏重大谋杀案调查经验的短板很快显露出来。

sentences.en: Firstly, they didn't put a stop to boats coming and going from the island, giving the perpetrator or perpetrators the opportunity to flee.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们没有阻止船只进出岛屿，给了凶手逃跑的机会。

sentences.en: Secondly, their failure to properly secure the crime scene led to curious tourists and locals contaminating the scene as they gathered around to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 其次，他们未能妥善保护犯罪现场，导致好奇的游客和当地人聚集围观，破坏了现场。

sentences.en: Some members of the public even took photos with their mobile phones and quickly posted them to social media.
sentences.zh: 一些公众甚至用手机拍照，并迅速发布到社交媒体上。

sentences.en: Before long, graphic images of Hannah and David's mutilated bodies were circulating online, much to the horror of the victim's loved ones,
sentences.zh: 没过多久，汉娜和大卫惨遭毁容的遗体照片就在网上流传，这让受害者的亲人们感到无比惊恐，

sentences.en: who were grappling to come to terms with the news back home.
sentences.zh: 他们在家乡正努力接受这个噩耗。

sentences.en: Although a motive for the murders wasn't immediately obvious, police didn't think it was a random attack.
sentences.zh: 虽然谋杀动机并不明显，但警方认为这并非随机袭击。

sentences.en: Given the extent of Hannah and David's injuries, they believed it was a crime of passion sparked by jealousy or anger.
sentences.zh: 考虑到汉娜和大卫伤势的严重程度，他们认为这是一起由嫉妒或愤怒引发的激情犯罪。

sentences.en: They questioned David's travel companion Chris Ware, who was highly distressed and unable to shed any light on the tragedy.
sentences.zh: 他们审问了大卫的旅伴克里斯·韦尔，他当时极度痛苦，无法为这起悲剧提供任何线索。

sentences.en: Police were suspicious.
sentences.zh: 警方对此表示怀疑。

sentences.en: Chris had an injury on his right hand, which he insisted was the result of a prior accident.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的右手有伤，他坚称这是之前意外造成的。

sentences.en: He said he and David had been due to leave Katao the day after the murders, and they'd made no enemies during their time on the island.
sentences.zh: 他说他和大卫本应在谋杀案发生后的第二天离开龟岛，他们在岛上期间没有结下任何仇怨。

sentences.en: He couldn't think of any reason why someone would want to hurt David, who was widely adored by those who knew him.
sentences.zh: 他想不出为什么有人会伤害大卫，大卫在认识他的人中广受喜爱。

sentences.en: Likewise, Hannah's friends had no information that could help with the investigation.
sentences.zh: 同样，汉娜的朋友们也没有提供任何有助于调查的信息。

sentences.en: With no evidence to link Hannah or David's friends to the crime, police gave them permission to leave the island.
sentences.zh: 由于没有证据将汉娜或大卫的朋友与犯罪联系起来，警方允许他们离开该岛。

sentences.en: However, they soon realised this was a mistake.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们很快意识到这是一个错误。

sentences.en: Forensic examination of Hannah's body revealed fragments of blonde hair in her hand.
sentences.zh: 对汉娜遗体的法医检查显示，她手中握有金发碎片。

sentences.en: This was significant given that Chris was blonde whereas David's hair was brown.
sentences.zh: 鉴于克里斯是金发，而大卫是棕发，这一点意义重大。

sentences.en: A subsequent inspection of the hotel room David and Chris had shared also revealed there was dried blood on a pair of David's pants.
sentences.zh: 随后对大卫和克里斯合住的酒店房间进行的检查也发现，大卫的一条裤子上有干涸的血迹。

sentences.en: Police began to wonder whether David and Chris could have been involved in some kind of love triangle that went violently awry.
sentences.zh: 警方开始怀疑大卫和克里斯是否卷入了某种演变成暴力的三角恋。

sentences.en: Two days after Hannah and David's bodies were found,
sentences.zh: 在发现汉娜和大卫遗体的两天后，

sentences.en: Chris Ware and his older brother James were stopped for further questioning at Bangkok International Airport as they attempted to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·韦尔和他的哥哥詹姆斯在试图离开泰国时，在曼谷国际机场被拦下接受进一步审问。

sentences.en: James had spent time with David and Chris on Katao, but had left the island the night before the murders had occurred.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯曾在龟岛上与大卫和克里斯待过一段时间，但在谋杀案发生的前一天晚上就离开了该岛。

sentences.en: Regardless, police ordered the brothers to stay in Thailand until the results of DNA testing came back.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是命令这对兄弟留在泰国，直到DNA检测结果出来。

sentences.en: News of the murders made international headlines, creating a public relations nightmare for Thailand, where tourism accounts for 10% of the economy.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案的消息登上了国际头条，给泰国带来了公关噩梦，旅游业占泰国经济的10%。

sentences.en: Roughly 20 million tourists visit the country each year, but those numbers had recently been under threat.
sentences.zh: 每年约有2000万游客访问泰国，但这一数字最近受到威胁。

sentences.en: In May of 2014, a military coup had overthrown the democratically elected government and Thailand had since been under martial law.
sentences.zh: 2014年5月，一场军事政变推翻了民选政府，此后泰国一直处于戒严状态。

sentences.en: The political instability combined with the fact that most travel insurance companies excluded cover for destinations where martial law is in place
sentences.zh: 政治不稳定，加上大多数旅游保险公司将戒严目的地排除在承保范围之外，

sentences.en: meant the number of foreigners visiting Thailand had been decreasing.
sentences.zh: 意味着访问泰国的外国人数量一直在减少。

sentences.en: With a brutal killer or killers targeting holidaymakers now on the loose, the pressure was on for authorities to make an arrest, and faSt.
sentences.zh: 随着一名或多名残忍的凶手在逃，针对度假者进行袭击，当局面临着必须迅速破案的压力。

sentences.en: Adding to the pressure was the fact that the neighbouring island of Koh Panyang had developed an unsavoury reputation that threatened to tarnish
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，邻近的帕岸岛声名狼藉，这威胁到要玷污

sentences.en: Katao's standing as a peaceful, relaxing tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 龟岛作为和平、休闲旅游目的地的地位。

sentences.en: Famous for its monthly full moon parties, which attracted upwards of 30,000 young revellers,
sentences.zh: 帕岸岛以每月一次的满月派对而闻名，吸引了超过3万名年轻狂欢者，

sentences.en: Koh Panyang had become notorious for drugs, sexual assaults, and robberies.
sentences.zh: 该岛因毒品、性侵犯和抢劫而臭名昭著。

sentences.en: Many locals believed the same criminals who preyed on tourists on Koh Panyang were taking advantage of Katao's growing party scene.
sentences.zh: 许多当地人认为，在帕岸岛上掠夺游客的罪犯，正在利用龟岛日益兴起的派对场景。

sentences.en: Thailand's self-appointed Prime Minister,
sentences.zh: 泰国自封的总理，

sentences.en: Army Chief General Prayuthan Orsha, appeared on television to address the issue of tourist safety.
sentences.zh: 陆军总司令巴育·占奥差将军出现在电视上，讨论游客安全问题。

sentences.en: He then added that only tourists who were, quote, not beautiful should feel safe in bikinis, a comment that sparked international outrage
sentences.zh: 他随后补充说，只有“不够漂亮”的游客穿比基尼才安全，这一言论引发了国际社会的愤怒，

sentences.en: and required the General to issue a public apology.
sentences.zh: 并迫使将军公开道歉。

sentences.en: Within days, 60 police officers had descended on Katao to expedite the investigation.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，60名警察涌入龟岛，以加快调查进度。

sentences.en: Upon inspecting the crime scene, the island's most senior police officer concluded one thing, there was no way the murders were committed by a Thai person.
sentences.zh: 在检查犯罪现场后，岛上最高级别的警官得出一个结论：谋杀案绝不可能是泰国人所为。

sentences.en: He believed Thais simply weren't capable of carrying out such a horrendous act of violence.
sentences.zh: 他认为泰国人根本没有能力做出如此残暴的暴力行为。

sentences.en: Instead, police focused their attention on foreigners.
sentences.zh: 相反，警方将注意力集中在外国人身上。

sentences.en: Yet, the semen staining found on Hannah Witheridge's body was determined to have come from two Asian males.
sentences.zh: 然而，在汉娜·威瑟里奇遗体上发现的精液痕迹被确定来自两名亚洲男性。

sentences.en: The DNA of these men was also found on the L&M cigarette butts along with the DNA of a third Asian male.
sentences.zh: 这些人的DNA也在L&M烟头上被发现，同时还有第三名亚洲男性的DNA。

sentences.en: As a result, the Ware brothers were officially cleared from the investigation and free to return to the UK.
sentences.zh: 因此，韦尔兄弟被正式排除在调查之外，可以自由返回英国。

sentences.en: Thai police were now forced to look inwards for potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 泰国警方现在被迫向内寻找潜在嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The AC bar where Hannah and David were last seen was known to be frequented by groups of aggressive drunken men
sentences.zh: 汉娜和大卫最后一次露面的AC酒吧，据称经常有成群结队的醉酒男子出没，

sentences.en: and it was theorised that Hannah might have had a confrontation with one who then followed her and David as they walked back to their hotel.
sentences.zh: 有人推测汉娜可能与其中一人发生了冲突，那人随后在他们走回酒店时跟踪了他们。

sentences.en: Another possibility was that fishermen could have swam ashore from their boat to commit the crimes, then fled by sea without anyone ever knowing they were in the area.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是，渔民可能从船上游到岸边实施犯罪，然后从海上逃走，没有人知道他们曾出现在该地区。

sentences.en: Police began focusing on the large migrant Burmese community that dominated the island.
sentences.zh: 警方开始关注岛上占主导地位的庞大缅甸移民群体。

sentences.en: For the roughly 2,000 permanent residents on Katao, there were approximately 5,000 Burmese workers who flocked from their neighbouring country of Myanmar looking for employment.
sentences.zh: 龟岛约有2000名常住居民，而大约有5000名缅甸工人从邻国缅甸涌入这里寻找工作。

sentences.en: Given that they were willing to work for less money than the Thais,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们愿意以比泰国人更低的工资工作，

sentences.en: Burmese made up a majority of the island's labour force.
sentences.zh: 缅甸人构成了岛上劳动力的主体。

sentences.en: Many were undocumented and often exploited and treated disrespectfully by Thais who considered them to be of a lower social standing.
sentences.zh: 许多人没有合法证件，经常受到泰国人的剥削和不尊重，泰国人认为他们的社会地位较低。

sentences.en: Burmese workers who lived or worked within the vicinity of the crime scene were rounded up en masse and required to provide DNA samples and footprints
sentences.zh: 居住或工作在犯罪现场附近的缅甸工人被大规模搜捕，并被要求提供DNA样本和脚印，

sentences.en: to compare to those left in the sand at the murder scene.
sentences.zh: 以便与谋杀现场沙地上留下的痕迹进行比对。

sentences.en: Documentation was also checked to identify those who were working in the country illegally.
sentences.zh: 警方还检查了证件，以识别那些非法在泰国工作的人。

sentences.en: Raids were done on several homes and five Burmese men were put under the spotlight after bloodstains were found on some of their clothes.
sentences.zh: 警方突袭了几个住所，在发现五名缅甸男子的衣服上有血迹后，他们成为了重点怀疑对象。

sentences.en: All up, over 200 DNA samples were collected but none were a match to the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 总共收集了200多个DNA样本，但没有一个与犯罪现场匹配。

sentences.en: 25-year-old Scottish musician Sean McKenna had been living on Katao for some time and was a friend of David Miller's from back home.
sentences.zh: 25岁的苏格兰音乐家肖恩·麦肯纳在龟岛生活了一段时间，是大卫·米勒在家乡的朋友。

sentences.en: Crushed to hear what had happened,
sentences.zh: 听到发生的事情，他感到心碎，

sentences.en: Sean deeply regretted not going to the AC bar with David on the night he was killed.
sentences.zh: 肖恩非常后悔在大卫遇害的那晚没有和他一起去AC酒吧。

sentences.en: In the days following the murders, he'd heard many rumours circulating around the island, including that two Thai men had attempted to molest Hannah and David had stepped in,
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案发生后的几天里，他听到了岛上流传的许多谣言，包括两名泰国男子试图骚扰汉娜，大卫挺身而出，

sentences.en: prompting the Thais to kill the pair.
sentences.zh: 导致泰国人杀害了两人。

sentences.en: Drowning his woes at a local bar, a group of local Thai men approached Sean and started asking him questions about his friend.
sentences.zh: 在当地一家酒吧借酒消愁时，一群当地泰国男子走近肖恩，开始问他关于他朋友的问题。

sentences.en: Feeling tipsy, Sean answered them before one of the men allegedly said,
sentences.zh: 醉意朦胧的肖恩回答了他们，随后其中一名男子据称说道：

sentences.en: It was you who killed them.
sentences.zh: “是你杀了他们。”

sentences.en: You've got two people's deaths on your hands.
sentences.zh: “两条人命在你手上。”

sentences.en: You are going to hang yourself tonight.
sentences.zh: “你今晚会自缢身亡。”

sentences.en: We are going to watch you hang.
sentences.zh: 我们要看着你被绞死。

sentences.en: You die tonight.
sentences.zh: 你今晚就得死。

sentences.en: Terrified, Sean got up and ran.
sentences.zh: 肖恩吓坏了，起身就跑。

sentences.en: He sprinted into a nearby supermarket but two of the men followed him inside.
sentences.zh: 他冲进附近的一家超市，但其中两名男子跟着他进了店。

sentences.en: Thinking quickly about how to protect himself,
sentences.zh: 在快速思考如何保护自己时，

sentences.en: Sean logged into Facebook on his phone and posted a photo of the men along with the message,
sentences.zh: 肖恩用手机登录了Facebook，发布了一张这些男子的照片，并附上消息：

sentences.en: Thai Mafia are trying to kill me.
sentences.zh: 泰国黑帮正试图杀我。

sentences.en: Please help me.
sentences.zh: 请帮帮我。

sentences.en: The police eventually escorted Sean back to his hotel but, fearing for his life, he fled into the jungle where he hid overnight
sentences.zh: 警方最终护送肖恩回到了酒店，但由于担心自己的生命安全，他逃进了丛林，在那里躲了一整晚，

sentences.en: before boarding the first boat off Katao in the morning.
sentences.zh: 然后在早上登上了离开龟岛的第一班船。

sentences.en: He then met up with the reporter for the Daily Telegraph to tell his story, saying he believed the men who approached him knew who had killed Hannah and David
sentences.zh: 随后，他会见了《每日电讯报》的记者讲述了他的故事，称他相信那些接近他的人知道是谁杀了汉娜和戴维，

sentences.en: and were looking for a scapegoat.
sentences.zh: 并且正在寻找替罪羊。

sentences.en: They wanted Sean to take his own life so that it would fit with their narrative that the killer was a Westerner.
sentences.zh: 他们想让肖恩自杀，这样就符合他们关于凶手是西方人的说法。

sentences.en: When the video of Sean talking about this encounter circulated online, some astute viewers noticed that he had a two centimetre long wound on his right forearm
sentences.zh: 当肖恩讲述这次遭遇的视频在网上流传时，一些敏锐的观众注意到他的右前臂上有一道两厘米长的伤口，

sentences.en: that looked remarkably similar to one on David Miller's shoulder.
sentences.zh: 看起来与戴维·米勒肩膀上的伤口惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Photos also circulated on social media of Sean's guitar, which he had left on Katao and it appeared to be splattered with blood.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上也流传着肖恩吉他的照片，他把吉他留在了龟岛，上面似乎溅满了血迹。

sentences.en: Suspicions arose that Sean could have been involved in the murders, possibly in conjunction with some of his Thai friends, and had created the story about being threatened
sentences.zh: 人们开始怀疑肖恩可能参与了谋杀案，可能与他的一些泰国朋友串通，并编造了被威胁的故事，

sentences.en: in order to detract attention from himself.
sentences.zh: 以转移人们对他的注意力。

sentences.en: Sean strongly disputed these allegations, explaining that the injuries and blood had come from a bike accident days before the murders.
sentences.zh: 肖恩强烈否认了这些指控，解释说伤口和血迹是谋杀发生前几天的一次自行车事故造成的。

sentences.en: He left the country and went off the grid.
sentences.zh: 他离开了这个国家，从此销声匿迹。

sentences.en: Unlike other parts of the world, in Thailand, the term mafia doesn't necessarily relate to organised crime, but to the influential families that hold a monopoly over certain areas.
sentences.zh: 与世界其他地方不同，在泰国，“黑帮”一词并不一定指有组织犯罪，而是指在某些地区拥有垄断地位的有影响力家族。

sentences.en: Katao initially served as a political prison, with its first permanent inhabitants arriving in the 1930s, long before any authorities.
sentences.zh: 龟岛最初曾作为政治监狱使用，第一批常住居民于20世纪30年代抵达，远早于任何官方机构。

sentences.en: While Katao had since been resettled into a tourist haven, these families still dominated the island, owning a majority of the land and businesses.
sentences.zh: 虽然龟岛后来被重新安置为一个旅游胜地，但这些家族仍然统治着该岛，拥有大部分土地和企业。

sentences.en: They held great power and were generally considered the unofficial leaders of the island, the go-to people when any problems arose.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有巨大的权力，通常被认为是岛上的非官方领导人，是出现任何问题时人们求助的对象。

sentences.en: The richest and most influential family on Katao was the Dowichian family.
sentences.zh: 龟岛上最富有、最有影响力的家族是道奇安家族。

sentences.en: Feared by many, they owned a majority of the businesses on Siree Beach, including the AC bar and resort where David and Hannah were last seen alive.
sentences.zh: 他们令许多人感到恐惧，拥有赛里海滩上的大部分企业，包括戴维和汉娜最后一次露面时的AC酒吧和度假村。

sentences.en: At the head of the family was Warapan Dowichian, followed closely by his brother
sentences.zh: 家族首领是瓦拉潘·道奇安，紧随其后的是他的兄弟

sentences.en: Mondri Watt, better known as Mon.
sentences.zh: 蒙德里·瓦特，也就是大家熟知的“蒙”。

sentences.en: Mon had been the first person to arrive at the crime scene after the beach cleaner alerted him to the discovery of the bodies.
sentences.zh: 在海滩清洁工提醒他发现尸体后，蒙是第一个到达犯罪现场的人。

sentences.en: When footage from the scene was broadcast on the news, it struck many as odd that Mon was allowed to join the police in the cordoned-off area.
sentences.zh: 当现场画面在新闻中播出时，许多人觉得奇怪，蒙竟然被允许与警察一起进入警戒区。

sentences.en: He was seen freely walking around the crime scene, which skeptics believe gave him the opportunity to contaminate any evidence while providing a valid explanation as to why
sentences.zh: 人们看到他在犯罪现场自由走动，怀疑论者认为这让他有机会破坏任何证据，同时为为什么

sentences.en: any of his DNA might be found.
sentences.zh: 可能会发现他的DNA提供了合理的解释。

sentences.en: Suspicions immediately arose that the Thai Mafia were involved in the murders and were working in conjunction with the police to make the problem go away.
sentences.zh: 人们立即怀疑泰国黑帮参与了谋杀案，并与警方勾结以掩盖问题。

sentences.en: Some Thai police had a reputation for corruption and were often accused of accepting bribes and protecting those in positions of power.
sentences.zh: 一些泰国警察以腐败著称，经常被指控收受贿赂并保护那些掌权者。

sentences.en: Bolstering these theories was the fact that Mon Dowichian was one of the men that Sean McKenna had photographed after they followed him into the supermarket urging him
sentences.zh: 支持这些理论的事实是，蒙·道奇安正是肖恩·麦肯纳在他们跟踪他进入超市并催促他

sentences.en: to take his own life.
sentences.zh: 自杀后拍下的那几个人之一。

sentences.en: The other was a police officer.
sentences.zh: 另一个人是一名警察。

sentences.en: As accusations of a cover-up gathered momentum, the police announced they wouldn't be swayed by any local influence and that the Mafia would be looked into like anyone else.
sentences.zh: 随着掩盖真相的指控愈演愈烈，警方宣布他们不会受到任何地方势力的影响，黑帮也会像其他人一样受到调查。

sentences.en: Just over a week after the double homicide, police announced that Mon Dowichian had been taken into custody for questioning after he was captured in CCTV footage in the vicinity
sentences.zh: 双重谋杀案发生一周多后，警方宣布蒙·道奇安已被拘留审问，因为他在监控录像中被拍到出现在

sentences.en: of the crime scene around the time the murders took place.
sentences.zh: 谋杀发生时犯罪现场附近。

sentences.en: They also sought to arrest
sentences.zh: 他们还试图逮捕

sentences.en: Mon's nephew,
sentences.zh: 蒙的侄子，

sentences.en: 22-year-old
sentences.zh: 22岁的

sentences.en: Numpsod Dowichian, who bore resemblance to another figure captured in the footage and was reported to have fled the island shortly after the murders.
sentences.zh: 南索德·道奇安，他与录像中捕捉到的另一个人长相相似，据报道在谋杀案发生后不久就逃离了该岛。

sentences.en: Rumours swelled that Numpsod had hired a speedboat in the early hours of September 15 and was seen speeding towards the mainland, leaving his family to cover for him.
sentences.zh: 谣言四起，称南索德在9月15日凌晨租了一艘快艇，被目击到飞速驶向大陆，留下他的家人为他掩护。

sentences.en: Numpsod was eventually located, but he claimed he hadn't been on
sentences.zh: 南索德最终被找到，但他声称他当时根本不在

sentences.en: Katao at the time of the murders at all.
sentences.zh: 龟岛上。

sentences.en: He said he'd been over 400 kilometres away at university in Bangkok and even had stills taken from CCTV footage to prove it.
sentences.zh: 他说他当时在400多公里外的曼谷上大学，甚至还拿出了监控录像的截图来证明这一点。

sentences.en: Concluding this to be a solid alibi,
sentences.zh: 认定这是一个确凿的不在场证明，

sentences.en: Numpsod was publicly cleared from the investigation, as was his uncle
sentences.zh: 南索德被公开排除在调查之外，他的叔叔

sentences.en: Mon.
sentences.zh: 蒙也一样。

sentences.en: Mon later explained on the Channel 4 documentary
sentences.zh: 蒙后来在第四频道纪录片

sentences.en: Murder in Paradise that the real reason he'd chased
sentences.zh: 《天堂谋杀案》中解释说，他追赶

sentences.en: Sean McKenna into the supermarket was because he wanted to question him about the blood on his guitar.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·麦肯纳进超市的真正原因是，他想就肖恩吉他上的血迹盘问他。

sentences.en: By now, online sleuths had become fixated on the case and they remained convinced that the mafia were involved in Hannah and David's murders.
sentences.zh: 此时，网络侦探们已经对这起案件着了迷，他们仍然坚信黑帮参与了汉娜和戴维的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Examining the CCTV stills of Numpsod
sentences.zh: 检查南索德·道奇安在曼谷的监控截图时，

sentences.en: Dohichien in Bangkok, they noticed that the footage hadn't come from the university at all, but from the lobby of Numpsod's
sentences.zh: 他们注意到录像根本不是来自大学，而是来自南索德

sentences.en: Bangkok apartment next door.
sentences.zh: 隔壁曼谷公寓的大堂。

sentences.en: It was timestamped at 9.15am on September 15, several hours after the murders were thought to have taken place.
sentences.zh: 时间戳显示是9月15日上午9点15分，距离推测的谋杀发生时间已经过去了几个小时。

sentences.en: Some online sleuths speculated that the look of the lobby was outdated, indicating the footage had been captured some time ago, but there was no evidence to support this.
sentences.zh: 一些网络侦探推测大堂的样子过时了，表明录像是在很久以前拍摄的，但没有证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: Allegations arose that the stills were fake and concerned citizens called for CCTV footage from the university itself to be released.
sentences.zh: 有人指控这些截图是伪造的，相关市民呼吁公布大学本身的监控录像。

sentences.en: Regardless, police closed the book on the Dohichien family.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，警方结案了对道奇安家族的调查。

sentences.en: Frustrated by the accusations against his family,
sentences.zh: 对针对他家族的指控感到愤怒，

sentences.en: Katao Headman
sentences.zh: 龟岛村长

sentences.en: Warrapan Dohichien announced a bizarre challenge.
sentences.zh: 瓦拉潘·道奇安宣布了一个离奇的挑战。

sentences.en: If anyone could prove that his family were involved in Hannah and David's murders, he'd pay them one million baht, the equivalent to around
sentences.zh: 如果有人能证明他的家族参与了汉娜和戴维的谋杀案，他将支付一百万泰铢，相当于大约

sentences.en: 40,000 Australian dollars.
sentences.zh: 4万澳元。

sentences.en: Two weeks passed without any significant breakthroughs in the case.
sentences.zh: 两周过去了，案件没有任何重大突破。

sentences.en: The police came under criticism from the British press for chasing the wrong leads, publicly naming suspects who were later cleared, and for wrongly jumping from one suspect
sentences.zh: 警方因追查错误线索、公开点名后来被洗清嫌疑的嫌疑人，以及在没有完全完成每条调查线索的情况下错误地从一个嫌疑人

sentences.en: to the next without fully completing each line of inquiry.
sentences.zh: 跳到另一个嫌疑人而受到英国媒体的批评。

sentences.en: Thai police rejected an offer of assistance from the
sentences.zh: 泰国警方拒绝了来自

sentences.en: British embassy, saying they were confident that an arrest would soon be made.
sentences.zh: 英国大使馆的协助提议，称他们有信心很快就能逮捕凶手。

sentences.en: One BBC journalist remarked,
sentences.zh: 一位BBC记者评论道：

sentences.en: Watching the
sentences.zh: 看着

sentences.en: Thai police struggle to answer this mystery with the eyes of the world on them has felt like being part of a sometimes farcical performance in which we, the media, are the
sentences.zh: 泰国警方在全世界的注视下努力解开这个谜团，感觉就像是在参与一场有时荒诞的表演，而我们媒体就是

sentences.en: audience.
sentences.zh: 观众。

sentences.zh: 赛里海滩周围大约有300个

sentences.zh: 在宣布逮捕时，警方最初称凶手在看到汉娜和大卫“做爱”时产生了冲动，但这种解释根本站不住脚。

sentences.en: For one, David's DNA wasn't found on
sentences.zh: 首先，在大卫身上没有发现

sentences.en: Hannah's body, meaning the pair hadn't had sex.
sentences.zh: 汉娜的DNA，这意味着两人并没有发生性关系。

sentences.en: Secondly, to say that the killers had been spontaneously motivated by sexual desire contrasted scientific studies about what drives men to rape women.
sentences.zh: 其次，称凶手是受性欲自发驱动的说法，与关于男性强奸动机的科学研究相矛盾。

sentences.en: A majority of psychologists believe that rape isn't driven by lust, but is usually an act of premeditated violence driven by the desire for power and control.
sentences.zh: 大多数心理学家认为，强奸并非由欲望驱动，通常是出于权力和控制欲的蓄意暴力行为。

sentences.en: For some, the police misunderstanding served as further proof that they were creating a narrative against the two accused in the absence of any real motive.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，警方的这种误解进一步证明了他们在缺乏真实动机的情况下，编造了针对两名被告的叙事。

sentences.en: There was also the question of whether
sentences.zh: 此外还有个问题，即

sentences.en: Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio were physically capable of overpowering two victiMs.
sentences.zh: 佐林和威皮欧是否有能力制服两名受害者。

sentences.en: Both of the Burmese men were very slight in stature, only standing around five foot tall, whereas David Miller was roughly six foot two with an athletic build.
sentences.zh: 这两名缅甸人身材非常瘦小，身高只有五英尺左右，而大卫·米勒身高约六英尺二英寸，体格健壮。

sentences.en: Striking David in the head, overpowering him and dragging his body into the water while simultaneously restraining Hannah would have been no easy feat for two men of the accused
sentences.zh: 对于这两个被告体型的男人来说，击打大卫头部、制服他并将其尸体拖入水中，同时还要控制住汉娜，绝非易事。

sentences.en: size.
sentences.zh: （续上句）

sentences.en: Furthermore, twenty days had passed between the murders taking place and Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio being arrested, yet the pair had made no attempt to flee the island.
sentences.zh: 此外，从谋杀发生到佐林和威皮欧被捕已经过去了二十天，但两人并没有试图逃离该岛。

sentences.en: Reports stated that Wei-Pio was arrested when trying to escape on a boat to Surat Thani, but
sentences.zh: 有报道称威皮欧在试图乘船逃往素叻他尼时被捕，但

sentences.en: Wei-Pio claimed he'd simply been visiting the mainland to start a new job.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧声称他只是去大陆找新工作。

sentences.en: If the two Burmese migrants were responsible for the murders, it made sense that they would have left the island as soon as possible to escape not
sentences.zh: 如果这两名缅甸移民是谋杀案的凶手，那么他们理应尽快离开该岛，以逃避

sentences.en: just the authorities, but also the local mafia.
sentences.zh: 不仅是当局，还有当地黑帮的追捕。

sentences.en: These details aside, some were also suspicious about the police handling of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 撇开这些细节不谈，一些人对警方处理证据的方式也感到怀疑。

sentences.en: David's body and clothing belonging to both him and Hannah had been moved shortly after officers first arrived at the crime scene, potentially disturbing evidence.
sentences.zh: 大卫的尸体以及属于他和汉娜的衣物在警察首次到达现场后不久就被移动了，这可能破坏了证据。

sentences.en: Police explained they did this to avoid the items being washed away by the Tide, but the Tide had already gone out for the day and it was therefore unlikely that
sentences.zh: 警方解释说这样做是为了防止物品被潮水冲走，但当时潮水已经退去，因此物品不太可能

sentences.en: the items would be dragged away by the current.
sentences.zh: 被水流冲走。

sentences.en: Human rights groups had been following Hannah and
sentences.zh: 人权组织一直在关注汉娜和

sentences.en: David's case and were concerned that Zor-Lin and
sentences.zh: 大卫的案件，并担心佐林和

sentences.en: Wei-Pio had been treated unfairly.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧受到了不公正的对待。

sentences.en: From the get-go, it was clear that police didn't want the killer to be Thai.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，很明显警方就不希望凶手是泰国人。

sentences.en: Not only had one of the lead investigators said there was no way a Thai person could be capable of such a crime, the sub-district head of Katao commented,
sentences.zh: 不仅其中一名首席调查员曾说泰国人不可能犯下这种罪行，涛岛（Koh Tao）的副区长也评论道：

sentences.en: If another foreigner killed Hannah and David, then the damage for us won't be too bad.
sentences.zh: 如果杀害汉娜和大卫的是其他外国人，那对我们的损害就不会太大。

sentences.en: If it's something else, it could really hurt our reputation.
sentences.zh: 如果是其他情况，可能会严重损害我们的声誉。

sentences.en: When Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio were arrested, the DNA consent forms and statements they signed were both written in Thai.
sentences.zh: 当佐林和威皮欧被捕时，他们签署的DNA同意书和声明都是用泰语书写的。

sentences.en: However, neither of the Burmese men could speak or read Thai.
sentences.zh: 然而，这两名缅甸人既不会说也不会读泰语。

sentences.en: They'd been provided with a Burmese translator, but he wasn't an official court-appointed translator.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然被提供了一名缅甸语翻译，但他并非法院指定的官方翻译。

sentences.en: He was a Burmese pancake vendor who spoke neither Thai nor Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio's native Rakhine dialect.
sentences.zh: 他是一名缅甸煎饼小贩，既不会说泰语，也不懂佐林和威皮欧的母语若开语。

sentences.en: The pancake vendor was also part of an ethnic minority that had a long history of conflict with Myanmar's Rakhine state, which is where Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio came from.
sentences.zh: 这名煎饼小贩还属于一个与缅甸若开邦（佐林和威皮欧的家乡）有长期冲突历史的少数民族。

sentences.en: There were also concerns that the public re-enactment, which human rights groups viewed as antiquated, would harm the accused's right to a fair trial.
sentences.zh: 人们还担心，被人权组织视为过时的公开重演，会损害被告获得公平审判的权利。

sentences.en: Officials from the Myanmar Embassy visited Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio in jail, along with members of Thailand's National Human Rights Commission, the Lawyers' Council of Thailand,
sentences.zh: 缅甸大使馆的官员与泰国国家人权委员会、泰国律师协会的成员一起探望了狱中的佐林和威皮欧，

sentences.en: and the Migrant Workers' Rights Network.
sentences.zh: 还有移民工人权利网络。

sentences.en: They determined that both men were naive, uneducated, and easily coerced.
sentences.zh: 他们认定两人天真、没受过教育，且容易受到胁迫。

sentences.en: Along with the forced DNA testing and questionable translator, the accused hadn't been appointed a lawyer or told of their rights.
sentences.zh: 除了强制DNA检测和有问题的翻译外，被告也没有被指派律师，也没有被告知他们的权利。

sentences.en: They didn't seem to understand the full weight of the crimes they'd been accused of, nor the fact that they wouldn't be released any time soon.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎并不完全理解所受指控的严重性，也不明白他们短期内无法获释的事实。

sentences.en: Another detail that couldn't be overlooked was the fact that the two young men appeared to be sporting several bruises.
sentences.zh: 另一个不容忽视的细节是，这两名年轻人身上似乎有多处淤青。

sentences.en: Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio told these organisations that what really happened on the night of the murders was that they'd met at Mormor's workplace,
sentences.zh: 佐林和威皮欧告诉这些组织，谋杀案当晚真实发生的情况是，他们在莫莫的工作场所见面，

sentences.en: which was part of a resort owned by the Dorwichian family.
sentences.zh: 那是多维奇安（Dorwichian）家族拥有的度假村的一部分。

sentences.en: They waited around for Mormor to finish and the trio then purchased some beer and cigarettes from a 7-Eleven before riding a motorbike down to Siree Beach.
sentences.zh: 他们等莫莫下班，三人随后在7-Eleven买了些啤酒和香烟，然后骑摩托车去了赛里海滩。

sentences.en: At around 2am, they sat on a fallen log playing a guitar that Zor-Lin had brought with him.
sentences.zh: 凌晨2点左右，他们坐在倒下的原木上，弹奏着佐林带来的吉他。

sentences.en: It was dark and they couldn't see more than roughly 5 metres in front of them.
sentences.zh: 当时天很黑，他们看不清前方约5米以外的地方。

sentences.en: They spent roughly an hour playing the guitar while passing the beers and cigarettes between them.
sentences.zh: 他们花了一个小时左右弹吉他，期间轮流喝啤酒、抽烟。

sentences.en: Mormor then left for a while, at which point Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio made another quick trip to the convenience store to buy two more bottles of beer.
sentences.zh: 随后莫莫离开了一会儿，这时佐林和威皮欧又去便利店快速买了另外两瓶啤酒。

sentences.en: Shortly after they returned to the beach, Mormor rejoined them, but he didn't stay long before heading off to visit his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 回到海滩后不久，莫莫又加入了他们，但他没待多久就去见女朋友了。

sentences.en: It started to lightly rain, so Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio decided to call it a night.
sentences.zh: 天开始下起小雨，所以佐林和威皮欧决定结束当晚的活动。

sentences.en: As they made their way along the beach, Zor-Lin decided to take a quick dip in the sea in the hopes of curbing a nagging headache.
sentences.zh: 当他们沿着海滩走时，佐林决定去海里游个泳，希望能缓解恼人的头痛。

sentences.en: He placed the guitar down and jumped into the water fully clothed.
sentences.zh: 他放下吉他，穿着衣服跳进了水里。

sentences.en: Wei-Pio decided to join him, taking off his shoes and shirt and piling them onto the shore.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧决定加入他，脱掉鞋子和衬衫，堆在岸上。

sentences.en: They swam for around 15 minutes, and when they got out,
sentences.zh: 他们游了大约15分钟，当他们出来时，

sentences.en: Wei-Pio's shoes, shirt and the guitar were missing.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧的鞋子、衬衫和吉他都不见了。

sentences.en: There was a group of about 20 people watching a fire-twirling show outside the AC bar, but other than that, they hadn't seen anyone pass by.
sentences.zh: 当时有一群大约20人在AC酒吧外看火舞表演，除此之外，他们没看到任何人经过。

sentences.en: At no point did they see Hannah Witheridge or David Miller.
sentences.zh: 他们自始至终都没有看到汉娜·威瑟里奇（Hannah Witheridge）或大卫·米勒。

sentences.en: The two men walked around looking for their belongings but couldn't find them, so they decided to make the short walk back to Mormor's bungalow,
sentences.zh: 两人四处寻找财物但没找到，于是决定步行回莫莫的平房，

sentences.en: taking a shortcut down a nearby laneway.
sentences.zh: 抄近路走了一条附近的小巷。

sentences.en: Mormor was still at his girlfriend's house, so Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio let themselves inside.
sentences.zh: 莫莫当时还在他女朋友家，所以佐林和威皮欧自己进了屋。

sentences.en: Zor-Lin hung his wet clothes out to dry and went to bed, but Wei-Pio couldn't relax.
sentences.zh: 佐林把湿衣服挂起来晾干就去睡觉了，但威皮欧无法放松。

sentences.en: The missing shirt he'd been wearing belonged to Mormor and he wanted to return it, plus he needed his shoes for work the next day.
sentences.zh: 他穿的那件丢失的衬衫是莫莫的，他想还回去，而且他第二天工作还需要鞋子。

sentences.en: Wei-Pio returned to the beach on his own but still couldn't find the missing iteMs.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧独自回到海滩，但仍没找到丢失的物品。

sentences.en: Admitting defeat, he walked back to Mormor's house, finding an iPhone and pair of sunglasses along the way, which he decided to keep.
sentences.zh: 无奈之下，他走回莫莫家，途中发现了一部iPhone和一副太阳镜，他决定留下它们。

sentences.en: He got back to Mormor's bungalow around 4am, with Mormor returning from his girlfriend's shortly after.
sentences.zh: 他大约凌晨4点回到莫莫的平房，莫莫不久后也从女朋友家回来了。

sentences.en: The next morning, Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio returned to the village where they both lived.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，佐林和威皮欧回到了他们居住的村庄。

sentences.en: Wei-Pio showed the iPhone to his friend Ran.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧向他的朋友兰（Ran）展示了那部iPhone。

sentences.en: Wei-Pio tried to turn the phone on, but it required a passcode, so he plugged it into Ran's charger and left it there before heading off for work.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧试图打开手机，但需要密码，于是他把它插在兰的充电器上，然后就去上班了。

sentences.en: When Ran later heard about Hannah and David's murders, he panicked.
sentences.zh: 当兰后来听说汉娜和大卫被谋杀的消息时，他惊慌失措。

sentences.en: Realising that Wei-Pio had found the iPhone right near the crime scene,
sentences.zh: 意识到威皮欧是在犯罪现场附近捡到的iPhone，

sentences.en: Ran smashed the phone to pieces and hid it behind his house out of fear that he'd be implicated in the crime.
sentences.zh: 兰把手机砸得粉碎，并藏在屋后，生怕自己被牵连进这起罪案中。

sentences.en: The two accused claimed this was the same version of events that they'd given when they were first taken in for questioning, but the police didn't believe them.
sentences.zh: 两名被告声称，这就是他们最初被带去讯问时给出的版本，但警方不相信他们。

sentences.en: Instead, they'd taken DNA samples without Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio's consent and forced them to sign documents written in Thai which they didn't understand.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们在未经佐林和威皮欧同意的情况下采集了DNA样本，并强迫他们签署了他们看不懂的泰语文件。

sentences.en: When Zor-Lin denied committing the murders, the Burmese translator attacked him, threatening that he'd be killed and thrown to sea.
sentences.zh: 当佐林否认谋杀时，缅甸翻译攻击了他，威胁说他会被杀并扔进海里。

sentences.en: The translator urged him to confess, saying that he'd only get four or five years in prison as opposed to certain death.
sentences.zh: 翻译催促他认罪，说他只会坐牢四五年，而不是必死无疑。

sentences.en: Both men claimed that police tortured them by stripping them naked and leaving them in heavily air-conditioned rooms with blindfolds and handcuffs on.
sentences.zh: 两人都声称警方通过剥光他们的衣服，将他们留在开着强力空调的房间里，并戴上眼罩和手铐来折磨他们。

sentences.en: A plastic bag was placed over Zor-Lin's head in an attempt to suffocate him.
sentences.zh: 一个塑料袋被套在佐林的头上，试图让他窒息。

sentences.en: Wei-Pio was beaten and had his testicles electrocuted.
sentences.zh: 威皮欧遭到殴打，睾丸还受到了电击。

sentences.en: At one point, the police allegedly said that other Burmese workers had been burnt to death on the island and warned,
sentences.zh: 有一次，警方据称说岛上还有其他缅甸劳工被活活烧死，并警告说：

sentences.en: Those who don't have passports don't have rights.
sentences.zh: “没有护照的人就没有权利。”

sentences.en: If they disappear, nobody would notice.
sentences.zh: 如果他们消失了，没人会注意到。

sentences.en: Humiliated, terrified, and in agony,
sentences.zh: 在受尽屈辱、恐惧和痛苦之后，

sentences.en: Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio eventually couldn't take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 佐林和温波最终再也无法忍受了。

sentences.en: Both men reluctantly confessed to the crime.
sentences.zh: 两人不情愿地承认了罪行。

sentences.en: At no point were they informed of the charges against them or of their rights to a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他们从未被告知所受的指控，也未被告知他们有权聘请律师。

sentences.en: When Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio were whisked off to Siree Beach to stage a re-enactment the next day, they claimed the Burmese translator dictated their every move,
sentences.zh: 第二天，当佐林和温波被带到塞里海滩进行现场重演时，他们声称缅甸语翻译口述了他们的一举一动，

sentences.en: instructing them what to do and say.
sentences.zh: 指示他们该做什么、说什么。

sentences.en: A legal team from the Lawyers' Council of Thailand agreed to take on the case pro bono, and almost two months after Hannah and David's murders,
sentences.zh: 泰国律师协会的一个法律团队同意免费接手此案。在汉娜和戴维遇害近两个月后，

sentences.en: Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio formally retracted their earlier statements and both declared that they'd be pleading not guilty to the crime.
sentences.zh: 佐林和温波正式撤回了之前的供词，并均表示对罪行不认罪。

sentences.en: Myanmar officials warned that unfair treatment of Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio could harm the relationship between the two countries,
sentences.zh: 缅甸官员警告称，对佐林和温波的不公正对待可能会损害两国关系，

sentences.en: but Thai police staunchly denied the allegations of torture.
sentences.zh: 但泰国警方坚决否认了有关酷刑的指控。

sentences.en: They maintained that their interrogations had been done by the book and both of the accused had confessed at their own volition.
sentences.zh: 他们坚称审讯是按程序进行的，两名被告都是自愿认罪的。

sentences.en: The public prosecutor stated that the retracted confessions wouldn't have any impact on the case due to the strength of the forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 检察官表示，由于法医证据确凿，撤回供词不会对案件产生任何影响。

sentences.en: The families of Hannah Witheridge and David Miller slammed the reports that Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio had been used as scapegoats and expressed confidence in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 汉娜·威瑟里奇和戴维·米勒的家人抨击了关于佐林和温波被当作替罪羊的报道，并表示对调查充满信心。

sentences.en: From what we have seen, the suspects have a difficult case to answer.
sentences.zh: 从我们目前所见的情况来看，嫌疑人面临的处境十分艰难。

sentences.en: The evidence against them appears to be powerful and convincing.
sentences.zh: 针对他们的证据似乎强有力且令人信服。

sentences.en: For supporters of Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio, the DNA evidence that supposedly linked them to the crime scene was also dubious.
sentences.zh: 对于佐林和温波的支持者来说，据称将他们与犯罪现场联系起来的DNA证据也令人怀疑。

sentences.en: The authorities had never provided the detailed DNA test results, which should include statistical data analysis and a probability ratio.
sentences.zh: 当局从未提供详细的DNA检测结果，而这些结果本应包含统计数据分析和概率比率。

sentences.en: Instead, they merely presented a one-page report that contained handwritten alterations to the dates and no stamp to confirm that the DNA had been tested
sentences.zh: 相反，他们仅提交了一份单页报告，其中日期有手写修改，且没有盖章确认DNA是在

sentences.en: in a laboratory that complied with internationally accepted standards.
sentences.zh: 符合国际公认标准的实验室中进行检测的。

sentences.en: There was no documented chain of custody or case notes, as would be required in any Western country.
sentences.zh: 没有记录在案的监管链或案件记录，而这在任何西方国家都是必需的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, DNA testing is a complex process that can take a significant amount of time.
sentences.zh: 此外，DNA检测是一个复杂的过程，可能需要相当长的时间。

sentences.en: But in Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio's case, investigators were able to produce a result in around 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 但在佐林和温波的案件中，调查人员在大约24小时内就得出了结果。

sentences.en: These discrepancies prompted accusations that the DNA evidence had either been planted or manipulated to frame the accused.
sentences.zh: 这些差异引发了人们的指控，称DNA证据要么是被栽赃的，要么是被篡改以陷害被告。

sentences.en: Jane Torpen, an Australian expert on DNA profiling who looked at the evidence, said,
sentences.zh: 查看了证据的澳大利亚DNA分析专家简·托彭表示：

sentences.en: Crime scenes are notoriously difficult to gather quality DNA samples from.
sentences.zh: 从犯罪现场收集高质量的DNA样本是出了名的困难。

sentences.en: Cases like the one on Katao, which deal with mixed samples, are fraught with danger.
sentences.zh: 像龟岛（Katao）这样涉及混合样本的案件，充满了风险。

sentences.en: Complex and sometimes unreliable statistical calculations must be carried out to determine the probability that someone other than the accused could match the recovered sample.
sentences.zh: 必须进行复杂且有时不可靠的统计计算，以确定除被告之外的其他人与所提取样本匹配的概率。

sentences.en: Torpen challenged the police's statement that the DNA was confirmed to have come from the accused, explaining,
sentences.zh: 托彭对警方关于DNA已证实来自被告的声明提出了质疑，并解释道：

sentences.en: DNA profiling is predicated on statistics.
sentences.zh: DNA分析是基于统计学的。

sentences.en: That's the whole point.
sentences.zh: 这才是重点所在。

sentences.en: You don't just say it's a match.
sentences.zh: 你不能仅仅说这是一个匹配。

sentences.en: It's not fingerprinting.
sentences.zh: 这不像指纹识别。

sentences.en: You need to give significance to that match.
sentences.zh: 你需要赋予这种匹配以意义。

sentences.en: For the sceptics, one major question remained.
sentences.zh: 对于怀疑论者来说，一个主要问题仍然存在。

sentences.en: If Zor-Lin and Wei-Pio didn't kill Hannah and David, then who did?
sentences.zh: 如果佐林和温波没有杀害汉娜和戴维，那又是谁干的呢？

sentences.en: Katao was advertised as a safe destination and it was widely reported that a Westerner hadn't fallen victim to a homicide on the island for over a decade.
sentences.zh: 龟岛曾被宣传为一个安全的旅游目的地，据广泛报道，十多年来岛上没有西方人死于他杀。

sentences.en: But some believed this wasn't necessarily the case.
sentences.zh: 但有些人认为事实未必如此。

sentences.en: Prior to Hannah and David's murder, a couple of incidents had occurred that had people talking.
sentences.zh: 在汉娜和戴维遇害之前，曾发生过几起引起人们议论的事件。

sentences.en: In August 2012,
32-year-old British IT consultant Ben Harrington was holidaying on Syree Beach with his brother and a friend when he ventured out on a motorbike to get a beer at a nearby bar.
sentences.zh: 32岁的英国IT顾问本·哈林顿与他的兄弟和一位朋友在塞里海滩度假时，骑摩托车去附近的一家酒吧喝啤酒。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Ben's lifeless body was found on the side of a quiet road.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，本的遗体在一条安静的路边被发现。

sentences.en: Police determined that he had accidentally ridden the bike into a cement electricity pole, fatally breaking his neck to the point that it was twisted back 180 degrees.
sentences.zh: 警方认定他是不小心骑车撞到了水泥电线杆，导致颈部骨折，扭转了180度而丧命。

sentences.en: Ben's family wasn't convinced.
sentences.zh: 本的家人并不相信。

sentences.en: Thai authorities were eager to cremate Ben's body straight after his death, but the Harringtons refused and fought hard to have Ben's remains repatriated for a post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 泰国当局急于在事发后立即火化本的遗体，但哈林顿一家拒绝了，并极力争取将本的遗体运回国进行尸检。

sentences.en: When his body was returned, his wallet and cash were missing, leading the Harringtons to suspect that Ben might have been robbed and then killed to cover it up.
sentences.zh: 当他的遗体被运回时，他的钱包和现金不见了，这让哈林顿一家怀疑本可能是被抢劫后为了灭口而被杀害的。

sentences.en: An autopsy performed in the UK revealed there were no marks on Ben's neck, nor was his neck broken.
sentences.zh: 在英国进行的尸检显示，本的脖子上没有任何痕迹，脖子也没有断裂。

sentences.en: A coronial inquest was unable to determine whether Ben had indeed died of an accident, but confirmed his death was due to a ruptured aorta caused by some sort of collision.
sentences.zh: 验尸官无法确定本是否确实死于事故，但确认他的死因是某种碰撞导致的主动脉破裂。

sentences.en: Fifteen months later, the four-member Pearson family travelled to Katao from their home in the English city of Derby to ring in the New Year together.
sentences.zh: 十五个月后，四口之家的皮尔逊一家从他们位于英国德比市的家中前往龟岛，一起迎接新年。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, they celebrated with dinner at a Siree Beach restaurant before retiring to the nearby Hillside Resort at around 1.30am.
sentences.zh: 除夕夜，他们在塞里海滩的一家餐厅共进晚餐庆祝，随后于凌晨1点30分左右回到附近的希尔赛德度假村休息。

sentences.en: Twenty-five-year-old Nick Pearson had injured his knee a few days prior and required help from his father to hobble to his bungalow, but other than that, he was in good spirits.
sentences.zh: 25岁的尼克·皮尔逊几天前膝盖受了伤，需要父亲的帮助才能蹒跚走到平房，但除此之外，他精神状态良好。

sentences.en: The next morning, when Nick's family went to check on him, the door to his room was locked, but Nick wasn't inside.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当尼克的家人去查看他时，房间的门锁着，但尼克不在里面。

sentences.en: Shortly after, scuba divers traversing the waters in front of the Hillside Resort found Nick's body floating in the sea.
sentences.zh: 不久后，在希尔赛德度假村前海域穿行的水肺潜水员发现了漂浮在海面上的尼克的遗体。

sentences.en: He was still wearing the same clothes that he'd worn to bed.
sentences.zh: 他身上穿的还是睡觉时穿的那套衣服。

sentences.en: Police determined that he'd drowned after likely falling 50 feet from his bungalow above, but for the Pearson family, this didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 警方认定他很可能是从上方50英尺高的平房坠落后溺水身亡，但对皮尔逊一家来说，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: For one,
sentences.zh: 首先，

sentences.en: Nick hadn't sustained a single broken bone.
sentences.zh: 尼克身上没有一处骨折。

sentences.en: The cliffside was also full of imposing boulders, and if Nick had fallen, one of the rocks would have likely caught his fall or his body would be badly injured.
sentences.zh: 悬崖边上到处都是巨大的岩石，如果尼克坠落，他很可能会被岩石挡住，或者身体会受到严重伤害。

sentences.en: Police considered it an open and shut case, but the Pearson family suspected foul play.
sentences.zh: 警方认为这是一起结案的事故，但皮尔逊一家怀疑其中有猫腻。

sentences.en: Rumours circulated that Nick could have gotten on the wrong side of locals after taking a liking to one of their girlfriends the day before his death.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，尼克在去世前一天因为看上了当地人的女朋友而得罪了他们。

sentences.en: When the Pearsons started making their own inquiries, they were warned to leave Kattow as there were powerful people who lived on the island.
sentences.zh: 当皮尔逊一家开始自行调查时，他们被警告离开龟岛，因为岛上住着有权有势的人。

sentences.en: Nick's body was returned to the UK, where a coroner was unable to exclude the possibility that he had been assaulted prior to his death and recorded an open verdict.
sentences.zh: 尼克的遗体被送回英国，验尸官无法排除他在死前遭到袭击的可能性，并记录为未决裁决。

sentences.en: When Nick's parents heard about the murders of Hannah Witheridge and David Miller,
sentences.zh: 当尼克的父母听说汉娜·威瑟里奇和戴维·米勒遇害的消息时，

sentences.en: Nick's mother Tracy told reporters for the Mirror,
sentences.zh: 尼克的母亲特雷西告诉《镜报》的记者：

sentences.en: We don't believe the men they've arrested for killing Hannah and David have anything to do with it.
sentences.zh: 我们不相信他们逮捕的杀害汉娜和戴维的人与此案有关。

sentences.en: It's just a plan to show the police have acted so they don't put tourists off.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了表明警方已经采取了行动，以免吓跑游客。

sentences.en: As soon as I saw the news about Hannah and David, I cried for them and their parents because I know how hard it is to get the truth on that island.
sentences.zh: 当我看到关于汉娜和戴维的新闻时，我为他们和他们的父母感到难过，因为我知道在那个岛上想要查明真相有多难。

sentences.en: For 23-year-old Sam Venning, his 2013 holiday to Kattow seemed like a distant memory, but when he saw the news about the double murders on Siree Beach, it all came rushing back.
sentences.zh: 对于23岁的萨姆·文宁来说，他2013年去龟岛度假的记忆似乎已经很遥远了，但当他看到关于塞里海滩双重谋杀案的新闻时，一切记忆都涌上心头。

sentences.en: The location where the crime took place was all too familiar.
sentences.zh: 案发地点对他来说太熟悉了。

sentences.en: Horror washed over Sam as he realised, it could have easily been me in that body bag.
sentences.zh: 萨姆意识到自己差点就成了那个裹尸袋里的人，恐惧感油然而生。

sentences.en: 15 months earlier,
sentences.zh: 15个月前，

sentences.en: Sam had been drinking at a Kattow bar with 20-year-old Canadian backpacker Carla Bartell.
sentences.zh: 萨姆曾与20岁的加拿大背包客卡拉·巴特尔在龟岛的一家酒吧喝酒。

sentences.en: When the venue closed, the pair headed down to the southern end of Siree Beach sitting on a wall near the exact spot that David and Hannah had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 酒吧打烊后，两人走到塞里海滩南端，坐在离戴维和汉娜遇害地点完全相同的一堵墙上。

sentences.en: Chatting in the dark, they suddenly heard a motorbike pull-up, followed by the scuffle of flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中聊天时，他们突然听到一辆摩托车停下的声音，紧接着是人字拖摩擦地面的声音。

sentences.en: Split seconds later, two masked men appeared.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟后，两名蒙面男子出现了。

sentences.en: Carla instantly got up and ran, screaming for help.
sentences.zh: 卡拉立刻起身逃跑，尖叫着求救。

sentences.en: Before Sam could fully comprehend what was happening, he felt something hard strike the side of his head.
sentences.zh: 萨姆还没完全明白发生了什么，就感觉到有什么坚硬的东西击中了他的头部侧面。

sentences.en: He fell backwards, the sand beneath breaking his fall.
sentences.zh: 他向后倒去，下面的沙子缓冲了他的跌落。

sentences.en: When he came to, moments later, blood was dripping down his face.
sentences.zh: 片刻后，当他醒来时，鲜血正顺着他的脸流下。

sentences.en: The men had disappeared, but Carla's hysterical screams still echoed through the night.
sentences.zh: 那几个人已经消失了，但卡拉歇斯底里的尖叫声仍在夜空中回荡。

sentences.en: Carla and Sam had no idea what motivated the attack, but they believed the perpetrators had been scared off by Carla's screaMs.
sentences.zh: 卡拉和萨姆不知道袭击的动机是什么，但他们相信袭击者是被卡拉的尖叫声吓跑的。

sentences.en: They didn't report the incident, choosing to forget and move on, but after Hannah and David were murdered, they wondered whether they might have narrowly escaped a similar fate.
sentences.zh: 他们没有报告这起事件，选择遗忘并继续生活，但在汉娜和戴维遇害后，他们怀疑自己是否侥幸逃过了一劫。

sentences.en: Carla and Sam didn't get a good look of their attackers through the dark, but they did notice one thing.
sentences.zh: 卡拉和萨姆在黑暗中没有看清袭击者的长相，但他们注意到了一件事。

sentences.en: The men were of average height and build, not short, like Zor Lin and Wei Pio.
sentences.zh: 这些人身高和体型都很普通，并不像佐林和温波那样矮小。

sentences.en: Realising this information could be vital to the Witheridge-Miller investigation, both Carla and Sam contacted the relevant
sentences.zh: 意识到这一信息对威瑟里奇-米勒案的调查可能至关重要，卡拉和萨姆都联系了相关的

sentences.en: Thai authorities wanting to provide a statement.
sentences.zh: 泰国当局，希望提供一份证词。

sentences.en: Neither of them ever heard another word.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未收到任何回音。

sentences.en: While Zor Lin and Wei Pio awaited trial, controversy continued to haunt Katao.
sentences.zh: 在佐林和温波等待审判期间，争议继续困扰着龟岛。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve of 2014,
sentences.zh: 2014年除夕夜，

sentences.en: 29-year-old Frenchman
sentences.zh: 29岁的法国人

sentences.en: Dimitri Povs welcomed the New Year by partying all night with a group of friends.
sentences.zh: 迪米特里·波夫斯与一群朋友彻夜狂欢，迎接新年。

sentences.en: Dimitri had been living on Katao and at around 11am on New Year's Day he headed home alone to his rented bungalow.
sentences.zh: 迪米特里一直住在龟岛，元旦上午11点左右，他独自一人回到了租住的平房。

sentences.en: Hours later, his lifeless body was found hanging from the rafters of his front balcony.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，他的遗体被发现悬挂在他前阳台的椽子上。

sentences.en: Police arrived and found a note nearby concluding it an open and shut case of suicide.
sentences.zh: 警方赶到现场并在附近发现了一张字条，断定这是一起结案的自杀事件。

sentences.en: But when photos circulated online, others were sceptical.
sentences.zh: 但当照片在网上流传时，其他人表示怀疑。

sentences.en: The noose, which was noticeably loose, had been fashioned from a pair of shoelaces and oddly, there were no significant marks around Dimitri's neck.
sentences.zh: 那个明显很松的绞索是用一双鞋带系成的，奇怪的是，迪米特里的脖子上没有明显的勒痕。

sentences.en: His loved ones were adamant that he'd given no indication that he'd been depressed or was having suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他的亲友坚称，他没有任何迹象表明他患有抑郁症或有自杀念头。

sentences.en: But most suspiciously, when Dimitri's body was found, his hands were tied behind his back.
sentences.zh: 但最可疑的是，当迪米特里的遗体被发现时，他的双手被反绑在身后。

sentences.en: Word on the island was that he'd been romantically interested in a woman who was involved with the local mafia.
sentences.zh: 岛上有传言说，他曾对一名与当地黑帮有染的女性产生过爱慕之情。

sentences.en: Just three weeks later, the parents of 23-year-old
sentences.zh: 仅仅三周后，23岁的

sentences.en: Christina Annesley became worried when they hadn't heard from their daughter in several days.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·安内斯利的父母在几天没收到女儿的消息后感到担忧。

sentences.en: Christina had recently travelled solo to Katao from England and had told her parents that she'd come down with a painful chest infection.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜最近独自从英国前往龟岛，并告诉父母她患上了严重的胸部感染。

sentences.en: At 6am on January 21,
sentences.zh: 1月21日早上6点，

sentences.en: 2015, a cleaner found
sentences.zh: 2015年，一名清洁工发现

sentences.en: Christina deceased in her Siree Beach hotel room.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜死在她的塞里海滩酒店房间里。

sentences.en: She was lying face down with a bloody nose.
sentences.zh: 她脸朝下躺着，鼻子在流血。

sentences.en: Police determined that she'd died from natural causes after lethally mixing alcohol with antibiotics and painkillers, both of which she'd bought over the counter
sentences.zh: 警方认定她死于自然原因，因为她将酒精与抗生素和止痛药混合服用，而这两种药都是她在

sentences.en: at a nearby pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 附近的一家药店买的。

sentences.en: Christina's parents weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜的父母并不相信。

sentences.en: They'd heard the allegations of police cover-ups in Thailand and requested that their daughter's body be returned to the UK for an autopsy.
sentences.zh: 他们听说过泰国警方掩盖真相的指控，并要求将女儿的遗体运回英国进行尸检。

sentences.en: By the time
sentences.zh: 当

sentences.en: Christina's body arrived on home soil, it had already been embalmed, meaning that a toxicology report couldn't be conducted.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜的遗体抵达国内时，它已经被防腐处理过了，这意味着无法进行毒理学报告。

sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: With more suspicious deaths of tourists on Katao, tensions escalated as the trial of Zor Lin and Wei Pio drew near.
sentences.zh: 随着龟岛上发生更多游客死亡的疑案，随着佐林和温波的审判临近，紧张局势不断升级。

sentences.en: Reports continued to circulate that the police were covering for the mafia and that locals who knew the truth about who killed
sentences.zh: 有报道称警方在为黑帮掩盖真相，而那些知道谁杀害了

sentences.en: Hannah Witheridge and David Miller had fled the island out of concerns for their own safety.
sentences.zh: 汉娜·威瑟里奇和戴维·米勒真相的当地人，出于对自己安全的担忧已经逃离了该岛。

sentences.en: Lawyers for the defence were coming up against hurdle after hurdle.
sentences.zh: 辩护律师面临着重重障碍。

sentences.en: Not only were they denied access to a 900-page police report that formed the basis of the prosecution's case, witnesses from the Burmese community weren't willing to testify
sentences.zh: 他们不仅被拒绝查阅构成检方案件基础的900页警方报告，缅甸社区的证人也不愿出庭作证，

sentences.en: because they were too afraid to come forward.
sentences.zh: 因为他们太害怕而不敢站出来。

sentences.en: The defence team were forced to build their case by relying heavily on media speculation.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队被迫严重依赖媒体猜测来构建他们的辩护方案。

sentences.en: After being granted several extensions, the trial finally commenced in the Kost Samoye
sentences.zh: 在获得多次延期后，审判终于在2015年7月于苏梅岛

sentences.en: Provincial Court in July 2015.
sentences.zh: 省法院开始。

sentences.en: David Miller's parents and brother travelled to Thailand to be there for the proceedings, first stopping at the scene of the crime to lay mementos in David's honour.
sentences.zh: 戴维·米勒的父母和兄弟前往泰国参加诉讼，他们首先前往犯罪现场，为纪念戴维献上了纪念品。

sentences.en: David's father, Ian, said they had come with an open mind.
sentences.zh: 戴维的父亲伊恩表示，他们是抱着开放的心态来的。

sentences.en: Acknowledging the speculation that was running rampant online,
sentences.zh: 在承认网上流传的猜测时，

sentences.en: Ian said,
sentences.zh: 伊恩说：

sentences.en: We are here for David because of his tragic death.
sentences.zh: 我们来到这里是因为戴维的悲剧性死亡。

sentences.en: We'll go with the flow as much as we can.
sentences.zh: 我们会尽可能顺其自然。

sentences.en: We won't comment on the trial process.
sentences.zh: 我们不会对审判过程发表评论。

sentences.en: We'll be dignified for David.
sentences.zh: 我们要为大卫保持尊严。
